entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, Alex. I... I hope you can help. I need to return something. I feel terrible about it, I've been a VeloFit customer for years.
I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase, but I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you tell me a bit more? What specifically is the issue with the item?
It's the Pro-Series cycling jersey. It's just... the wrong size. I thought it would stretch a bit, but it's just too tight across the chest. I was so excited for it, but I just can't wear it.
I understand, getting the right fit is crucial for comfort on a ride. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I was thinking about an exchange, but honestly, with the holidays, I just really need the money back right now. It's been a tough month.
I completely understand. Let me just pull up that order. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the jersey, delivered on November 27th. So, about 28 days ago.
Oh, has it been that long? I'm so sorry. I hope it's not too late.
Not at all. I've just checked our policy for you. Since that jersey is a standard item, it's well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.
Really? Oh, thank you! That is such a relief. You have no idea. I was so worried.

Of course. I'm happy to help. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending you an email right now with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Just pack the jersey back in its original packaging if you can, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. Thank you so much, Alex. You've really helped me out today. Merry Christmas.
You're very welcome. Merry Christmas to you as well. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that was it. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
